entities.name: PMID:25096990
observations: Ma et al. studied neonatal male rats exposed to CIHH simulating 3000-m altitude for 42 days; isolated hearts underwent 30-min ischemia and 60-min reperfusion.

CIHH blunted the I/R-associated increase in cardiomyocyte [Ca2+]i and preserved NCX current and sarcolemmal NCX1 protein; cardiac function recovery improved and infarct size decreased versus controls.
Bay K8644, ryanodine, and PKC inhibitor chelerythrine modified measured protective effects; abstract supports NCX involvement but does not establish NCX as the sole mediator.

entities.name: CIHH limits cardiac I/R calcium overload
observations: In neonatal rat hearts after I/R, CIHH reduced the rise in intracellular Ca2+ and preserved Na+/Ca2+ exchanger current and NCX1 protein; this supports protection involving NCX homeostasis, not exclusive mediation.

relations.to: CIHH limits cardiac I/R calcium overload
